articles.title: NASA maps show 2026 El Niño resembles 1997; NOAA sees 83% chance of strong conditions in 2027
articles.summary: Recent satellite observations reveal striking similarities between the anticipated 2026 El Niño and the notorious 1997 event. Elevated sea levels across the Pacific are raising alarm among scientists regarding its expected severity. This climatic shift could drastically alter global weather patterns, with countries like India potentially facing erratic monsoon conditions. Experts estimate an 83% likelihood of heightened intensity in early 2027, posing significant risks for various regions.
